San Donato-San Vitale — Bologna, Italy

In detail

The quartiere that holds both of Bologna's most-reported problem areas, which is why it is rated hardest. Piazza Verdi and via Zamboni — the heart of the university quarter, and a street most visitors walk to reach the Due Torri — are covered continuously by Il Resto del Carlino and BolognaToday for street dealing, night-time disorder and assaults; traders on via Zamboni have publicly described the situation as out of control, and the city runs repeated anti-degrado operations in the square. Further out, the Pilastro estate is a standing item at the Prefettura's provincial security committee, which reports constant territorial policing there. San Donato itself is described in local coverage as one of the city's most difficult areas, with dealing and juvenile crime. In daylight the university streets are simply busy and full of students; the rating is for after dark.
